title.en: Masayoshi Son's $3.1 billion deal: what did SoftBank actually buy?
title.zh: 孙正义的31亿美元交易：软银究竟买到了什么？

summary.en: SoftBank completes its DigitalBridge common-stock acquisition. Control of the asset manager is not ownership of every asset its funds manage.
summary.zh: 软银完成对DigitalBridge普通股的收购。控股资产管理公司，不等于买下其基金管理的全部资产。

title.en: Trump renames AI. What can change in 60 days?
title.zh: 特朗普给AI改名，60天能改变什么？

summary.en: A naming order for the executive branch, with proposed legislative language due in 60 days. It does not establish a scientific breakthrough.
summary.zh: 行政部门奉命改称SI，60天内须提出立法措辞。这不是机器能力突破的证明。
